headline: Aptus Value Housing Finance Q2 net profit rises 18% to Rs 267 crore
hook: Steady credit demand lifts quarterly profits
summary: Aptus Value Housing Finance reported an 18% increase in net profit to Rs 267 crore for the second quarter, driven by higher interest income. Total income rose to Rs 634 crore compared to Rs 554 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous year. Interest income also grew to Rs 551 crore from Rs 472 crore. Retail investors tracking housing finance companies can gauge the lender's asset growth and margin health from these figures.
why_it_matters: Earnings growth signals steady credit demand for housing finance.

headline: Aptus Value Housing Finance reports steady Q2 FY27 growth despite sector headwinds
hook: Steady AUM expansion amid wider NBFC pressures
summary: Aptus Value Housing Finance posted its financial results for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, recording a 20 percent growth in Assets Under Management. The performance comes amid ongoing stress within the non-banking financial company sector. The company maintained its asset quality through the quarter despite liquidity pressures. Indian retail investors tracking housing finance companies can evaluate this performance against broader sector trends.
why_it_matters: Housing finance lender demonstrates resilient growth against sector-wide stress.
